title: A quantitative full-B2 bound with an additional third-neighbor charge improvement

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let h(n)=n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent with the exact parameters in guarantee.remainder. There exist a fixed real K>0 and N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-K*h(n) for every integer n>=N. K is existential, not a specified coefficient. experiments.purpose: The positive part checks the radial and crossing-edge ceilings and the positive root floors. The remaining part checks the negative root floors and isolated-center rebate. Both parts are needed to establish the complete theorem.
